name: PLFantasyBot2026-27
description: A Premier League fantasy bot for the 2026/27 football season to create the best team week-by-week⚽️

paragraphs: Live for the 2026-27 season. The dashboard is deployed at plfantasybot2026-27.vercel.app — five strategies (Balanced, Conservative, Reactive, Differential, xG Experimental), each with a full 2025-26 validated backtest and a real, gameweek-by-gameweek 2026-27 squad history, complete with player photos and live injury/status badges. data/snapshots/ archives FPL's full API state every 30 minutes automatically (.github/workflows/data-snapshot.yml). Transfers are made manually, on purpose. No credential is stored anywhere in this repo or its Actions — model/livepipeline.py's --apply path exists…

Every finished 2026-27 gameweek is locked in as real, scored history the moment its results are final — each strategy's actual result feeds a running season total, and the next gameweek is planned from that real squad via normal transfer rules, not rebuilt from scratch each time (see plan.md). The 2025-26 numbers below are still the trustworthy ones for judging the model itself: full-season backtests where it never saw the result it was predicting. A handful of real gameweeks is still far too small a sample to draw conclusions from. Only Balanced has a season's worth of validated backtesting…

requirements.text: FPL retired password login, so FPLCOOKIE is the whole Cookie: request header copied from a signed-in browser — python3 model/livepipeline.py --check-auth verifies it works and prints the squad FPL currently holds without submitting anything.
